subject: Cards Processing API
detail: Holds high-privilege application permissions: Directory.ReadWrite.All, User.Read.All. Admin consent does not transfer between tenants.
remediation: Re-justify each permission, scope down, and re-consent in the target with a documented approval.

subject: Phishing-resistant admins
detail: Source enforces this control (CA005 Admins phishing-resistant MFA); target is 'none'. Migrated users and tier-1 apps would silently lose a regulatory-relevant control.
remediation: Deploy an equivalent policy to the target in report-only, review sign-in logs for a week, then enforce before the first wave.

subject: contoso-legacy.example
detail: Domain is verified in BOTH tenants. A domain can live in only one tenant, so mail flow and UPN suffix moves are blocked until it is released from one side.
remediation: Remove from the tenant that should not own it (after clearing references), then verify in the other. Schedule DNS TXT changes inside a freeze-safe window.

subject: proxyAddress conflict
detail: 6 SMTP addresses exist in both tenants. Exchange Online rejects the second owner, so those users cannot be provisioned and mail to the alias goes to the wrong mailbox.
remediation: Choose a single owner per alias, remove it from the other object, and convert to a shared mailbox or distribution group where appropriate.

subject: SWIFT Alliance Access SSO
detail: SAML signing certificate expires in 12 days, inside the migration window.
remediation: Roll the certificate once, in the target tenant, instead of twice.

subject: Customer Onboarding Bot
detail: Holds high-privilege application permissions: Mail.Send, User.Read.All. Admin consent does not transfer between tenants.
remediation: Re-justify each permission, scope down, and re-consent in the target with a documented approval.

subject: Users with no MFA registered
detail: 113 users (18%) have no strong authentication method. Inbound MFA trust only helps users who already registered; the rest hit a registration wall on day one.
remediation: Run a Temporary Access Pass campaign two weeks before each wave. Gate each wave on at least 98% registration.

subject: Block guests from tier1
detail: Source enforces this control (CA009 Block guests from tier1); target is 'none'. Migrated users and tier-1 apps would silently lose a regulatory-relevant control.
remediation: Deploy an equivalent policy to the target in report-only, review sign-in logs for a week, then enforce before the first wave.

subject: Sign-in frequency
detail: Source enforces this control (CA007 Sign-in frequency 4h for tier1); target is 'report-only'. Migrated users and tier-1 apps would silently lose a regulatory-relevant control.
remediation: Deploy an equivalent policy to the target in report-only, review sign-in logs for a week, then enforce before the first wave.

subject: Entra-joined devices
detail: 221 Entra-joined devices cannot be moved between tenants and must be re-provisioned (Autopilot reset); 315 hybrid-joined devices need their connection point or Cloud Sync re-pointed; 391 are Intune-enrolled and must be re-enrolled in the target.
remediation: Schedule device re-provisioning with the user's wave, not before. Pre-stage Autopilot hardware hashes into the target.

subject: contosolife.example
detail: Domain is federated (AD FS or third-party IdP). It must be converted to managed (PHS or PTA) before it can move, which changes every user's sign-in path.
remediation: Pilot staged rollout to managed authentication, then convert the domain. Keep the federation trust documented for rollback.

subject: Same person in both tenants
detail: 14 people hold an account in each tenant (matched on employeeId). Provisioning a second identity creates split mailboxes, duplicate licenses and broken audit trails.
remediation: Decide the surviving account per person, merge group and app access to it, soft-match before sync, retire the other after the wave.

subject: mailNickname collision
detail: 236 different people share a mailNickname across tenants. Cross-tenant sync and Exchange provisioning will fail or silently rename one of them.
remediation: Pre-assign a deterministic suffix, for example <nick>.cb, and record it in the mapping table.

subject: On-premises synced users
detail: 504 of 640 source users are mastered in on-premises AD. Cross-tenant sync can provision them, but source of authority stays in the old forest until it is consolidated or re-pointed.
remediation: Choose: (A) keep source AD and run Cloud Sync into the target tenant, or (B) migrate the forest with ADMT. Decide before wave 1 because it sets the hard-match strategy.

subject: VISIO_PLAN2
detail: 60 users need VISIO_PLAN2, which the target tenant does not own.
remediation: Add the SKU to the acquirer's agreement or map to an equivalent before wave 1.

subject: SPE_E3
detail: Need 420, free 225: short by 195 seats at full migration. Seats are exhausted during wave 4.
remediation: Purchase or true-up before the wave that crosses the limit. See wave plan for the exact crossing point.

subject: SPE_E5
detail: Need 220, free 95: short by 125 seats at full migration. Seats are exhausted during wave 5.
remediation: Purchase or true-up before the wave that crosses the limit. See wave plan for the exact crossing point.

subject: Excess Global Administrators
detail: 7 Global Administrators in the source. Merging unchanged would import standing privilege into the acquirer's tenant.
remediation: Do not sync privileged roles. Rebuild admin access in the target with PIM, break-glass accounts and phishing-resistant MFA.

subject: Ambiguous display names
detail: 250 users share a displayName with someone in the target. Not a technical blocker, but the GAL becomes ambiguous and helpdesk match-by-name errors will appear.
remediation: Append department or location to displayName in the unified GAL.

subject: Source guests
detail: 12 guest accounts exist in the source tenant. They do not move with cross-tenant sync and must be re-invited.
remediation: Export, de-duplicate against target guests, re-invite with B2B direct connect where possible.
